:::{#def-agent-only-rate}
#### Agent-only rate

The **agent-only rate** of an agreement table (@def-agreement-table)
is the proportion of observations
that the agent assigns a [positive classification](#def-positive-classification)
and the reference assigns a [negative classification](#def-negative-classification):

$$p_{\text{agent}} \eqdef \frac{b}{n}$$ {#eq-agent-only-rate}

:::
